page.overview:
Who is Bella-Ella?

She is described by Addy as being from old money: MySpace. She is one of the girls from Addy’s “crew”. According to Addy, she is unable to actually laugh or smile right because her mom used a lot of Botox when she was pregnant with her.

Bella-Ella has long brown hair worn in a ponytail and wears blue diamond-shaped earrings.
